en: Wh-who are you?
D-damn it! It was a trap!
You're not that beauty, but you're still prime goods! You'll do as my wife!
Huh? Where's our brother?
D-don't tell me he really got taken as a bride?
N-no way! They're both men!
B-but our little brother is dressed as a woman right now...
N-no... no way...
It's all my fault... if not for me, you wouldn't...
Please don't say that, miss! We got careless!
The Whale Fiend must have taken Pingyan back to its lair! Let's head there now!
It's no use! The Whale Fiend told me it lives in an undersea palace off the north shore of Yinmeng Lake. How could mere humans like us dive that deep?
Leave it to the She-devil to suggest something pointless.
What did you say, you old witch?! If you've got a better idea, let's hear it!
Ch-Chanyu, you two, stop fighting!
Big brother, have you thought of something?
I remember two mysterious Taoists at Jizhou Pass, the Idler and the Townsman, I think. Those brothers said we'd meet again soon... Let's go ask if they know a way!
What good are two smelly Taoists?
Better than charging underwater and drowning, right?
Why you...!
Let's head to Jizhou Pass!
If I'd just faced facts and married the Whale Fiend, you wouldn't be in danger...
Please don't say that! We'll beat the Whale Fiend and bring our brother home safe!
Good Taoists, I...
No need to say a word. We already know!
You want to know if we have a way to get you to the bottom of Yinmeng Lake!
You two really are divine...
Oh, you flatter us...
Take this Sea-Churning Shark! With it, diving to the depths of Yinmeng Lake is no trouble at all!
Go! Time is short!
Thank you, both of you!
Go! Time is short!
Until we meet again!
My saviors, you're back! Thank goodness!
Rest easy, miss! The Whale Fiend will never bother you again!
My steed, little Whale, ran wild and caused you grief... I offer you my deepest apologies.
Please, sister, there's no need to be so formal!
Well, it's all wrapped up nicely! Next we just get through Jizhou Pass, and we'll reach Zhaoge soon!
Jizhou Pass is guarded by General Su Hu, father of the court's consort, Su Daji! I doubt he'll let us through easily...
If talking fails, we just bust through!
Miss, is there something you want to say?
Since you're my saviors, I won't hide it any longer. The truth is, I am Su Hu's daughter, Su Daji...
S-Su Daji?
Th-that's impossible! Then who's the Su Daji in Zhaoge?
Miss, could you explain? This is no joking matter!

It went like this... King Zhou listened to the slander of the traitors You Hun and Shu Zhong and ordered my father to send me to the palace as a concubine. Torn and helpless, Father had no choice but to send me...
King Zhou, that lecherous fool, wrecking the court... it's just...

On the road to Zhaoge, we rested at the inn in Enzhou. That night, a loud crash in the courtyard woke everyone. We opened the doors and saw a beautiful girl lying in the yard... As we went to help her, a Nine-Tail Fox suddenly dropped from the sky and slipped into the girl's body... She fainted, and nothing we tried could wake her...
Hmm... and then?
I suppose out of love for me, Father hatched a plan. After talking it over with my brother, they pulled a switch and sent that girl to Zhaoge in my place, while I hid here under another name...
No wonder you wouldn't tell us your name, no matter how we asked...

Forgive me... I never meant to speak the name Su Daji again. To the people, Su Daji is the wicked witch who led King Zhou to ruin, and now even incited Grand Tutor Wen to seize the throne. An unforgivable sinner...

Daji, don't worry! I, Nezha, promise you: in Zhaoge I'll clear your name! What's more, I'll tell the whole world and give you back the name Su Daji! You'll never have to hide in this little hut again!
Nezha... thank you... thank you...
Don't mention it! It's the least I can do!
Let's go to Jizhou Pass to find my father!
What are you spacing out for, Monkey-face?
N-nothing! Let's go, Busybody!
Young man? Troubled about finding girls' clothes?
H-how did you know? Who are you two? Why do you always know exactly where we are?
That's not for you to know, lad... There's no time! Take this Rainbow Feather Robe.
Seriously?
Seriously!
Hurry! We'll meet again soon...
Meet again soon? Why?
Don't ask so much! Just go!
What a weird pair of brothers...
Right! Got it! Time's short, back to Yinmeng Lake!
Need something?
20 silver a night.
Huh... why does this town look like a ruin?
Don't tell me the whole village died?
Huh? Looks like someone's over there. Let's take a look!
Okay!
Ma'am~ Why is nobody around in this town?

Well, this is Heishan Town. It used to be a lovely place of hills and streams, but for years now the fox fiends of the Xuanyuan Tomb have pestered us. Most villagers couldn't stand it and moved away...
How awful...
I'd say the most pitiful is Xiangling, little sister of Wu Ji, our village head. She's been frail since she was small, and with the foxes' mischief, her illness has gotten worse lately...
Those fox fiends...
Unforgivable!
So have these foxes ever actually endangered anyone's life?
Well, no... they just steal things and play pranks...
Hasn't anyone tried to deal with these naughty foxes?
They say on the night of the full moon, the foxes lose all their magic. When Wu Ji heard that, he led the other villagers to the Xuanyuan Tomb to burn their den...
Let's go see too!
Yeah!
Ma'am, do you know the way to the Xuanyuan Tomb?
It's northwest of Heishan Town...
Thanks! We're off!
The Xuanyuan Tomb is to the northwest! Be careful out there!
Whimper......
Chief Wu Ji! Hurry, burn them...
Well......

Chief! What are you hesitating for? Have you forgotten these foxes are why your sister Xiangling's bedridden? Tonight's the full moon, when they lose all their magic! It's a rare chance to deal with these beasts! If you go soft now...
Xiangling... You're right! I can't go soft! Don't blame me! Die!
Children~
Who just said that?
Maybe we heard wrong?
Mama~ Sob... help us~
Wh-who are you calling Mama?! I'm not even married! Where'd a pack of fox love-children come from?!
Heh heh... well, we wouldn't know about that...
Asking for a beating, She-devil?
Hmph! Beg all you like, I won't go soft again! Die!
Mama...... sob...
Sob sob sob sob...
Stop! Spare them!
Young man~ Are you in league with these foxes?
No! Heaven cherishes life. Besides, burning these foxes alive is just too cruel.

Do you know what these foxes have done for years? Running riot in our village, pranking us, giving Heishan no peace, and Xiangling never gets better... sob... So today, in the name of Wu Ji, head of Heishan, I will wipe them out...
From what I hear, these foxes only steal food and play pranks. They haven't hurt a single villager, right?
Th-that's true... but Xiangling...
Grudges are better settled than nursed. Killing these foxes might ease your anger today, but as I see it, you'd only be heaping bad karma onto your sister Xiangling...
Well......I never expected one so young to speak such wisdom... I, Wu Ji, am truly ashamed...
Will you promise the people of Heishan never to prank the town again?
I will... we promise!
We swear on our lives... we'll never come near Heishan again...
They've sworn on their lives! Let them go!
Kid, you're way too naive! What if they go back on it?
Yeah, yeah! Besides, why should we trust you?!
What are you saying? Do you know who we are...
Stop, Busybody!
This sword stroke is my pledge for the foxes.
M-Monkey-face... why go that far?
Now... can you... let them... go...
Savior... please hang in there...
Thank you... savior... We'll never forget your great kindness... Let me heal your wound right away...
What are you doing?
Busybody... let them... do it... I trust them...
Huh? My wound... Where did my wound go?!
So those foxes were healing him...
Back to Heishan!
What about the foxes?
Didn't they already promise never to come to Heishan again? Let them go!
Thank you, Wu Ji!
Mm!
Wu Ji, wait a moment!
My master gave me this elixir before he died. They say it cures any illness... It's yours!
Wh-what? I can't take something so precious...

Take it! Your sister Xiangling needs it more than I do. Besides, my master once told me the whole point of his lifelong study of the Tao was to help the unfortunate. I'm sure if he were here, he'd hand you this elixir without a second thought!
Thank you... thank you... I'll hurry back to Heishan and give it to Xiangling...
Thank you all...
We misjudged you before. Please forgive our rudeness...
No hard feelings! Hurry home!
Mm!
Thank you, savior! We'll never forget your kindness as long as we live!
We promise never to come near Heishan again!
Seems there's still something left to do. No need to rush off.
We'd better hurry to the Xuanyuan Tomb!
I hear you not only saved those little foxes, but gave Wu Ji an elixir? What good kids you are!
Sorry we were rude before...
I wonder if the elixir will cure Xiangling...
You've come.
Is your sister Xiangling awake?
She's been out cold for three days and nights...
I'm sure Xiangling will recover...
Mm! Oh, it's getting dark out. Stay in Heishan tonight!
Oh, we couldn't impose...
Let's stay! This town has plenty of empty rooms anyway...
Sis!
S-sorry...
Ha ha ha... it's fine! It's the truth, after all! Come on!
Sorry for the trouble!
Not at all! Follow me!
There. Get some good rest!
Mm! Thanks.
Zzz... zzz...
By order of Lady Daji and His Majesty, I must kill you... Pingyan... forgive me!
......I can't! I can't do it. The Lady's orders can't be defied, but he saved my children... he even hurt himself to win the villagers' trust. Someone like that... I can't do it...
Huh? Someone's coming!
This dope sure is sleeping soundly... You big idiot! Was it worth it, doing that for some foxes?
But that's so you...... smooch~
Xiangling, you're awake!
Big brother......what happened? I feel so full of energy, like I was never sick at all.
Xiangling... this is wonderful!
My savior! Please accept Wu Ji's bow!
D-don't do that! Please get up!

Thanks to your elixir, Xiangling is awake, and the foxes won't bother the village anymore. Starting tomorrow, as head of Heishan, I'll call back everyone who used to live here. I'll make Heishan what it once was!
Big brother... Xiangling will help too!
Mm!
I'm sure that someday soon, Heishan will be just like it used to be.
Then you have to come back and see Xiangling!
Okay, big brother promises! Once I finish my job, I'll come back to see you!
Pinky promise~
Pinky promise? Reminds me of someone...
Do you not like Xiangling?
Not at all! Okay! Pinky promise~
Ha ha ha... sorry she's so willful.
Not at all! It's getting late, and we've got urgent business. We'll be going.
Mm! Take care!
Take care now!
You have to come back and see Xiangling~ We pinky promised~
Savior, wait a moment!
This Blue Dragon Sword is the Wu family heirloom, passed down for generations. Please take it with you!
No way! I can't take such a precious heirloom...
For Xiangling's sake, didn't you give me your master's keepsake? Don't refuse!
No! Saving people is one thing, but this is your family heirloom. Keep it!
Hmm... then how about this! I'll just lend you the sword, and you return it when your work is done. You did promise Xiangling you'd come back to Heishan, didn't you?
All right! When it's done, I'll return the Blue Dragon Sword just as it is.
Mm! Don't you have to get going? Be careful on the road!
We'll be off, then! Xiangling, big brother will come see you when it's done!
Mm! Xiangling will wait for you!
I hear Xiangling's awake! Heaven really is watching over us!
Wonderful! Just wonderful! We'll call back everyone who left Heishan and make the town what it used to be!
Wow~ It's so pretty! Look!
Yeah! Rare for the Busybody to find anything pretty, though~
Asking for a beating, Monkey-face?
Wouldn't dare. So where are we, anyway?
Homeview Cliff!
Homeview Cliff? I bet it's named that because from the top you can see your hometown.
Exactly! Look, isn't that Heishan, the town we just left?
It really is!
Chanyu, are you thinking of your dad? Don't worry! Tu Xingsun figures your father has gotten the Yin brothers safely to Xiqi by now!
From this peak you can see Heishan, Xiqi, and our goal, Zhaoge.
Yin Wen's right there in Zhaoge, not far off...
Brother......
Don't think about that, Monkey-face. Oh! And don't forget your promise to Wu Xiangling!
Right! Before I go home, I've got to visit Xiangling! We pinky promised! Besides, I need to give this Blue Dragon Sword back to Wu Ji!
That Xiangling's pretty cute, huh?
Heh heh... yeah! Xiaojun was just like her as a kid. She'd only relax once we pinky promised.
Don't worry, brother! We'll find Xiaojun for sure!
How long are you two gonna chat? If we don't move, the sun'll set!
Right! It's getting late! Let's go!
Huh?
Did you see something, dear?
Something just flew out of Zhaoge!
Did it? Maybe you saw wrong, dear?
No mistake! Some power just shot out of Zhaoge!
Wh-what is that?
Th-that direction... isn't that Heishan?
Then what about Wu Ji and Xiangling?
Wu Ji~ Xiangling~!
Out of my way!!
I won't!
Busybody! I said move! You hear me?
You can't go back, Pingyan~ They're already...
No... they're not dead! I promised Xiangling I'd come back... I can still... still feel Xiangling's warmth on my fingertip... They're not dead! We pinky promised...
Monkey-face......
Who's there?
Too late?
Damn it! We were a step too slow!
Fate~ Truly, it is fate~
Grand Master?!
Your disciple greets you, Grand Master!
No need for ceremony. Why, it's Yuding's own disciple Yang Jian, and Taiyi's disciple Nezha!
Grand Master, why are you here? Has something happened?

Indeed! This calamity is the final showdown between the Jie Sect of Jin'ao Island and the Chan Sect of Mount Kunlun. To help Yin Wen, the new Yin ruler, fight our sect, the immortals of Jin'ao have laid out a forbidden formation on Juelong Ridge: the Myriad Immortals Array.
A forbidden formation? The Myriad Immortals Array?
To set up the forbidden Myriad Immortals Array, living souls must be offered in blood to the spirits of darkness...
D-don't tell me that fiery light heading for Heishan was......
Every villager of Heishan has become a blood offering for the Myriad Immortals Array...
Unforgivable!
Tu Xingsun won't forgive them either!
If only we'd noticed sooner......
We and the Jie Sect have long been at war, but both sides agreed on one thing: this forbidden art must never be used, no matter what.
Then why......
I hear the Array was summoned on the orders of Yin Wen, the new leader of the Jie Sect......
Yin Wen again?! How could he be the new leader of the Jie Sect?
Wen Zhong's spirit dwells in his body. Wen Zhong is the Jie Sect's idol, and lately they obey him in everything. And so, little by little, he became their leader.
For Wu Ji, for Xiangling! I'll kill you with my own hands... Yin Wen! They're on Juelong Ridge, right? Let's go! Up Juelong Ridge, now! I'll make those Jin'ao fiends pay in blood!
Wait!
What now?
As I said, the Array is no ordinary formation. Rush in recklessly, and even a reborn arhat would be wiped out without a trace.
So we just sit back and do nothing?

That is exactly why I came! Since Jiang Ziya gave you the Investiture List, the great task of the Investiture falls to you. It governs the balance of Heaven, Earth and Man, so the immortals of Kunlun will lend you a hand. There is no time to waste. To break the Array's power, you need the four divine swords! Together, their power can hold the Array in check for a time!
Four divine swords?
The Black Tortoise Sword, the Blue Dragon Sword, the Vermilion Bird Sword and the White Tiger Sword. You already have two. Before facing the Array, you must gain the help of the other two.
So where are those two swords?
The White Tiger Sword is in White Tiger Wood, not far south. The Black Tortoise Sword, as far as I know, is in Shen Gongbao's hands.
Shen Gongbao! Is it the sword he stole from my family's altar?

Correct! And Shen Gongbao is no longer the one we knew. Since returning from your era, he has absorbed this era's Shen Gongbao, and his power is beyond compare. Now he is Yin Wen's Imperial Advisor too, a tiger given wings! I believe his ultimate goal is to stop the Investiture and wreck the balance of the Three Realms. But rest assured, I have sent Chijingzi, Daoxing and Cihang to sneak into Zhaoge and steal the Black Tortoise Sword. Hurry to White Tiger Wood for the White Tiger Sword. We meet on Juelong Ridge in three days!
Got it! I'm on my way!
Heishan's nothing but ruins now!
White Tiger Wood is not far to the south!
Who'd have thought Jin'ao Island would resort to a forbidden art?
At last, the decisive battle with the Jie Sect is upon us.
Up ahead is the Myriad Immortals Array! We need the White Tiger Sword first!
This is no place for you to linger. Leave at once!
I am White Tiger, guardian of the White Tiger Sword~ This is no place for you to linger. Leave at once!
To break through the Array, we need your White Tiger Sword, sage!
You, break the Myriad Immortals Array? Ha ha ha~ Don't make me laugh! A bunch of brats like you?
Monkey-face! Why bother talking to him?
Big talk! Let me test your strength first!
Hmph! Like I'm scared of you!
Hmph! How's that? Still looking down on us?
Ha ha ha... you pass, you pass!
Pass what?

Actually, Lord Yuanshi told me long ago that a General Star would soon come to borrow the White Tiger Sword, and asked me not to give him trouble. But I figured: you may be a General Star, but you're about to face the Myriad Immortals Array. If you can't even get past me, why go to Juelong Ridge just to die?
I see. But lately everyone keeps calling me a General Star. What is a General Star, anyway?

Since ancient times, a General Star appears when the world is in chaos. The General Star is the savior who brings peace. By Lord Yuanshi's reckoning, Jiang Ziya was to come down the mountain and complete the Investiture, but soon after he did, he met an untimely death. All of Kunlun was shaken! Then they found that three General Stars had appeared, and realized a deeply mysterious, evil power was secretly undermining the Investiture. Even Lord Yuanshi doesn't know where it comes from.
A mysterious power? Is Jin'ao Island behind it?
We don't know that either. But one thing is certain: the key to unmasking this power lies with Shen Gongbao and Yin Wen!
What?

And so Lord Yuanshi understood that the three General Stars appeared to stop this power and complete the Investiture in Jiang Ziya's place. You are one of those stars. Coming to this era was your destiny.
Then what about the other two?
I'm ashamed to say we still can't find them. Their spirits seem to be veiled by some evil power!
So what exactly is the Investiture about?

In this era, mortals and immortals like us live side by side, so the line between Heaven, Earth and Man is blurred. If it goes on, the world will fall back into chaos and the universe will be destroyed. So Lord Yuanshi and the Kunlun immortals, by Heaven's mandate, created the Investiture List, to raise the destined immortals to divine posts in Heaven and keep the Three Realms distinct and the cosmos turning. But Shen Gongbao, expelled from Kunlun, hates the Chan Sect with a passion. He joined forces with their rival, Jin'ao Island, to wreck the Investiture, turn the mortal world into a demon realm, and crown Yin Wen and Wen Zhong as demonic lords of the Three Realms!
So... that's how it is!
This is outrageous!
We have to stop them!
Here is the White Tiger Sword! Take care on your way!
I will!
The Myriad Immortals Array is no ordinary formation. Be careful!
Who's there?
By order of the Yin King! I've come for the three divine swords you carry!
And you are?
You don't need to know who I am! You won't be alive much longer!
You think kung fu this shabby can take my life? Zhaoge must be out of talent!
We should get moving! The three-day deadline with Yuanshi is almost up!
Mm! Let's go!
Ah!
What are you yelping about, Busybody?
We never found out who he was!
Forget it! He's just some nobody anyway!
True! Let's go!
C-curse them... calling me... just some... nobody... I'm Zhao Gongming... chief alchemist of Jin'ao Island...
Heh heh heh... The Array's sacrificial rite is finally complete! Ha ha ha ha ha...
You've changed! To finish the Array, you used the people of Heishan as a blood offering! That's too cruel!
Maybe I really have changed. For the Lady, I'd do anything...
The Lady... You do whatever the Lady says. Is she always right? If she told you to die, would you?
I would!
You... you......You sacrificed so many innocent lives to finish the Array. Can you really live with that?

Heishan was sacrificed, yes, but villagers who die for their emperor should feel honored! Sooner or later I'll fight Pingyan to the death. If I keep even a shred of soft-heartedness, I'll never beat him. I won't live in his shadow anymore! I am Yin Wen! I am the emperor! I'll make the whole world bow to me! Ha ha ha ha.........
Yin Wen......sob sob......Why have you become like this.........
So you've finally come, brat!
Sh-Shen Gongbao?!
To make Yin Wen lord of the Shang, I'll slay the Kunlun immortals and every Xiqi rebel, and turn the mortal world into hell! Only then will my hatred be eased!
Did Yin Wen send you to kill me?
Sorry, it wasn't the Yin King. Lady Daji feared he'd go soft if he saw you, so she sent me to silence you all, and take the three divine swords while I'm at it!
Lady Daji?! Who is this Lady Daji, mother of the Shang realm? The real Su Daji was killed at Jizhou Pass...
Ha ha ha ha ha... What do you think?
Someone Yin Wen would obey without question......
Could it... could it be...?
Why tell him all this?! Get him, Monkey-face!
Right!
Heh heh... You've grown strong, brat~ A true heir of the Ji bloodline! We'll meet again, brat! Ha ha ha ha ha~
Don't run! Shen Gongbao!
Don't chase him, brother...
The Shang empress couldn't be... Xiao......
No way! You're overthinking it, brother!
Big brother's right! That Shen Gongbao is just trying to shake our morale, that's why he said it!
Don't you always tell us Xiaojun is a sweet, caring girl? She can't be the consort ruining the Shang!
Chanyu's right! Tu Xingsun doesn't think the Lady is Ji Xiaojun either!
We'll know the truth once we reach Zhaoge. For now, let's focus on the Array!
You're right! I shouldn't talk so gloomy before the big battle!
Let's go, brother!
Yeah!
If Zhaoge's Daji really is Ji Xiaojun, Monkey-face, what will you do......
Busybody, what are you spacing out for? Everyone's waiting!
I know, I know! Monkey-face!
Do you have the White Tiger Sword?
Thanks to you!
Did something happen?
I'm afraid we failed our mission.
For days we searched Zhaoge for any trace of Shen Gongbao. We combed the whole city, but couldn't find him anywhere!
Shen Gongbao isn't in Zhaoge. We just fought him at the foot of the mountain.
Really? Then the Black Tortoise Sword?
No luck~ Shen Gongbao didn't have the Black Tortoise Sword on him.
That sly Shen Gongbao...
This is bad......Without all four divine swords, how can we break the Array's seal......
Is that seal really that strong?
Indeed! Approach the Array before the seal is broken, and you'll melt into a puddle at the entrance, never mind getting inside!
